# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 3 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1/level-2 martial chassis baseline to level 3 as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
# It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from
# the level-1/level-2 fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded
# tranche needs. The level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist) is carried
# forward unchanged — PF1 also grants monks a SEPARATE bonus feat at 2nd
# level, but this slice deliberately does not add a second choice-slot for it
# (no fixture data and no recognition code exist for a level-2 bonus feat
# grant; it stays named but unproven, unchanged by this widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no ki pool, no
# execution of what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2
# bonus feat grant recognition, and no level-4+ progression. Still Mind (the
# 3rd-level monk class feature this fixture newly exercises) is grounded only
# as a bounded flat-magnitude record, never applied to any actual save total.
# Fast Movement and Maneuver Training, the other two entries in the PF1 CRB
# Monk class table's 3rd-level "Special" column, are deliberately left
# named-but-unproven this slice (no speed-total engine and no CMB/CMD engine
# exist in this codebase to attach either to).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level3
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:3
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:stunning_fist
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
